stem: Which lines from the poem best express the speaker’s anticipation of a future event?

options.label: F
options.text: Cracking the capsule of crystal that captures Your beautiful body and budding wings.

options.label: G
options.text: But someday I will meet your kin That will bring beauty back to my tree,

options.label: H
options.text: You leave behind your chrysalis husk That kept you safely wrapped in a bundle

options.label: J
options.text: They shimmer brightly in a new world; White dots and black stripes on rust.
